chosenApproach: Preserve every non-scope main blob, overlay exact non-manifest blob SHA identities from green Navigation V2 head 73c473caa4ebc139be4b231d3097760fe5c246e5 (49 paths) and green Wall/Marites stability head dc85ce6ed7bc46a1f314885b6fb1d2739e38dcb2 (4 paths) with no overlaps; add one consolidated V2 scope manifest and cross-feature behavioral integration test. Freeze as DEV candidate only, no release. One inherited Navigation ads test is adjusted to reference the integrated V2 scope path; the product-side source blobs remain exact. Extend isolated DEV scope by exact reviewed comment action blobs from PR #786 and read-only native staging APK attestation blobs from PR #789 (excluding their standalone scope manifests); add one isolated Android-staging compile-only QA workflow and include both source tests in prepublish OTA gates. No changes to production release workflows, native dependencies, SQL or live app. Add minimal in-place indexed offline Help and per-account first-use guidance; persist only bounded public Wall *text drafts* encrypted with SecureStore so process interruptions do not require retyping, while keeping all existing media/GIF and native player paths unchanged.
selectionRationale: One independent exact-source candidate establishes compile and regression compatibility without whole-merging source branch history, overwriting signed staging mirror changes, duplicating routes or modifying code already fixed in main. The source is a readiness candidate, not a deployment artifact. Comment UI repair is user-requested and compatible with unchanged comment RPC authorization. The read-only ADB verifier measures installed signed staging APK parity without touching production. Compile-only CI resolves an otherwise skipped Android RC verification gap.
alternativeApproaches: Independently merge #783 and #784 sequentially into main before cross-feature verification (rejected: risks automatic release triggers and unverified physical Android behavior).
Continue two fully separate PRs without ever testing combined source (rejected: cannot prove a single future RC behaves coherently).
Incorporate unverified SALIKSIK #780 backend migrations in the navigation release (rejected: unrelated RLS/points/feature flags and costly unsafe release dependencies).
